citations.long: The results and/or dates of management reviews are not documented.

citations.short: Evaluation and Selection, Suppliers, Contractors, etc.
citations.long: Potential suppliers were not sufficiently evaluated and selected on the basis of their ability to meet specified requirements.

Products that do not conform to specifications are not adequately controlled.

Complaints involving the possible failure of a device to meet any of its specifications were not reviewed where necessary.

citations.long: Reserve samples from representative sample lots or batches of drug products selected by acceptable statistical procedures are not examined visually at least once a year for evidence of deterioration.
